title: Release flow without pushes to main
description: Move the release-plz version bump to a local scripts/prepare-release.sh run on develop; release.yml on main only tags, publishes and creates the GitHub release, so no automation pushes to main and pudicus-receipt-gate can be required there.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Added scripts/prepare-release.sh, made release.yml publish-only (no update, commit, or push), and updated docs. release-plz release is a no-op when all packages are already published (per release-plz docs). release-plz not installed locally, so the script dry run was skipped.

right_now_summary: Version bumps now run locally, while main only tags, publishes packages, and creates GitHub releases.
